title: Born on the cusp? Read this
caption: You're not half Pisces, half Aries. The Sun was in one sign when you were born. Here's how to check.

beats.head: Born on a *cusp?*
beats.sub: You're not half one sign and half another.

beats.head: A cusp is just the *line* between two signs.
beats.sub: Like the border between two neighboring towns.

beats.head: When you were born, the Sun was in *one* sign.
beats.sub: Not two. The math picks a side, down to the minute.

beats.head: The dates you see are *averages.*
beats.sub: The switch can move by a day from year to year.

beats.head: Born near the switch? Check your *year* and birth time.
Still feel like *both?* That's real.
beats.sub: Your Moon, Mercury or Venus may sit in the next sign.

beats.head: Your Sun is one sign. Your chart holds *many.*
beats.sub: That's where the mix comes from.

beats.head: Dating a cusp baby? *Ask* for their birth time.
beats.sub: Then you'll know exactly who you're texting.

beats.head: Tag a friend who swears they're a *cusp.*
